metaTitle: Custom Rainbow Lapel Pins | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom rainbow lapel pins for Pride events, diversity initiatives, and more. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Rainbow lapel pins are a powerful way to show support for LGBTQ+ inclusion and diversity in the workplace. Whether for Pride Month campaigns, employee resource groups, or corporate values, these pins make a visible statement. Choose from soft enamel, die-struck, or cloisonné finishes, and add your logo or message on the back. Perfect for giveaways, uniform programs, or fundraising events. Order in bulk to equip your entire team with matching pins that celebrate inclusion.
heroAltText: Custom rainbow lapel pins in enamel finish with metal backing, displayed on a dark fabric background.
